Retrieve all exact IC50 activities in nM from binding or functional assays. Exact means only rows with standard_relation = '='. Exclude rows where standard_value is null or standard_relation is null. Return these columns exactly: canonical_smiles, compound_chembl_id, bao_endpoint, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, assay_type, organism, tid, target_chembl_id, and target_name. Use the raw assay_type code from assays.assay_type, the target organism from target_dictionary.organism, and the assay TID from assays.tid.
